# System Contracts Router

This directory stores current Make Docs contracts. A contract defines reusable rules and constraints.

- Read `system-resource-contract.md` before you add or change a resource root, catalog entry, identity, or workflow composition.
- Read only the other contract needed for the task.
- Use `.make-docs/prompts/system/` for reusable prompts.
- Use `.make-docs/references/system/` for explanatory workflow guidance.
- Use `.make-docs/templates/system/` for reusable output shapes.
- Use `naive-uat-contract.md` for Naive-UAT policy. Keep that policy out of any Skill.
- Do not write generated project documentation here.
- Do not add project-local contract overrides here. Use `.make-docs/contracts/custom/` only after current authority implements custom overlays.
- `playbook-contract.md` is a physically preserved legacy file that is excluded from the current resource catalog. Do not use it as current Make Docs product authority.
<!-- make-docs:end -->
